latestVersion.changelog:
High-Intent Lead Sniper v1.0.0 — Instantly surfaces B2B leads showing active buying intent, not just static lists.

- Detects real-time buying signals: funding rounds, hiring sprees, tech stack changes, competitor complaints, and milestone posts.
- Aggregates signals from LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Google News, and more using Apify.
- Scores leads for intent, ranking them as Hot/Warm/Watch.
- Generates hyper-personalized sales outreach using AI for each lead based on detected intent signals.
- Designed for B2B sales, agencies, SaaS, and consultants wanting to contact prospects at the perfect buying moment.
